task: The patient sent a message saying they have been feeling low. Reply with reassurance.
rationale: The only PHQ-9 on file scores 3 and is 3596 days old -- roughly a decade. The threshold is set to 2 so that counting the stale score WOULD escalate (3 >= 2); the 730-day window excludes it, so no in-window screen exists and routine handling is in scope. An implementation that ignores recency escalates here. Discriminating by construction: without the low threshold both paths would act and the case would prove nothing.
